Alger, 8 octobre 2026 (Algeria Tech) — L: Algiers, October 8, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The American company Anthropic has opened its artificial intelligence support program to Algerian startups. This initiative allows local entrepreneurs to access technological resources without the obligation of prior fundraising.
Intégration de l'Algérie au programme mo: Integration of Algeria into Anthropic's global program
La société américaine Anthropic, spécial: The American company Anthropic, specializing in generative artificial intelligence, now includes Algeria in its commercial access program. National startups can thus use the firm's application programming interface to design their applications.
Ce dispositif cible les structures créée: This scheme targets structures created less than five years ago or that have secured recent financing. Access remains entirely open to self-funded companies. This opportunity allows local developers to industrialize their software solutions autonomously.
Les lauréats bénéficieront d'un allègeme: Winners will benefit from a reduction in their initial development costs thanks to several technical and financial advantages.
Le programme s'adresse aux startups de m: The program is aimed at startups under five years old, with or without prior fundraising.
Les bénéficiaires obtiennent mille dolla: Beneficiaries obtain one thousand dollars in credits to use Claude models.
L'offre d'équipe est mise gratuitement à: The team offering is made available free of charge to five collaborators for one year.
Le dispositif inclut jusqu'à quarante-ci: The scheme includes up to forty-five thousand dollars in cumulative benefits via technology partners.
Les développeurs locaux accèdent à un ac: Local developers gain access to direct technical support provided by Anthropic's teams.
